analyst_view.overall: Early view: a Friday night game at the City Ground between a Forest side that beat Manchester City 3-1 before the break and a Chelsea side that lost 1-0 at Sunderland. Chelsea are still without Joao Pedro and Reece James, while Forest have Nicolo Savona and Nicolas Dominguez out. Both play on 21 November first, so this view will change with those results.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals, split evenly. Forest found their scoring touch with three against City, led by Delap, but Chelsea's attack has looked short of quality without Joao Pedro. Those cancel out, so I keep the site's number.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners. Chelsea's wide players and Forest's home push should both produce corners, and nothing in the news points either way yet.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards. I lean slightly higher: Chelsea were booked four times at Sunderland, including Caicedo and Colwill, and Forest near the bottom will play with intensity in front of a Friday night home crowd.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.1 shots. Forest's win over City showed they can create at home, but Chelsea will likely have more of the ball, so the site's split looks fair. I will revisit it after the 21 November games.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.5 shots on target. Chelsea's finishing has lacked sharpness without Joao Pedro, but Forest's forwards were clinical against City, so I stay with the site at this distance.
